notes: Source: 2021 Final Report, Anonymity-Protected Digital Edition (137 PDF pages; rosters on PDF pp. 128-136 = printed pp. 130-138). Virtual Conference (second ever), April 18-24, 2021. AREA 58 (Oregon) DISCREPANCY: the Area Delegates list prints 'James (Jim) F., Tillamook, OR (Panel 70)' (carried over from the 2020 list), but the Conference committee roster lists 'Amber N. - Area 58, Oregon' under PANEL 70 on Public Information; in the 2022 report Amber N. is the Panel 72 Oregon delegate. Amber N. most likely served the remainder of the Panel 70 term in 2021 (probably the alternate stepping up), but the report does not say so, so the delegate entry keeps the printed Area Delegates list (status 'delegate') and the PI committee member is recorded as printed ('Amber N.'). This causes the validator WARNING 'PI: area 58 member name ...'. Committee member and next-year-chair names use the Area Delegates list spelling (e.g. 'Gerardo (Jerry) S.' for roster 'Jerry S.', 'Jim A.' for next-year chair table 'Jimmy A.'). Conference committees: 11 primary committees + 2 secondary (Archives, International Conventions/Regional Forums, marked with footnote 1). Committee printed as 'Grapevine' (canonical GRAPEVINE). Finance secretary 'Zenny M.' and Archives secretary 'Michelle M.' are printed with full surnames (nonalcoholic employees) and reduced to the initial. Class A trustees and nonalcoholic employees are printed with full surnames in this edition; they are reduced to given name + surname initial, dropping middle names/initials, honorifics and suffixes (e.g. Leslie S. B. -> 'Leslie B.', Peter F. L., Ph.D. -> 'Peter L.' (committee rosters print 'Pete' -> 'Pete L.'), Sr. Judith Ann K., CSA, FACHE -> 'Judith Ann K.', Al J. M., III, MD... -> 'Al M.', Linda S. C., JD -> 'Linda C.', Kevin J. P., MBA, CFA, CPA -> 'Kevin P.', Molly A. A. -> 'Molly A.'). Class B names are kept exactly as printed (e.g. 'Francis H. G.', 'Patricia (Trish) L.'), except 'Ginger R.B.' (printed 'Ginger R.B' in the committee lists) which is written 'Ginger R. B.' (the same form used in the 2017-2020 files) so the compound surname initial passes the anonymity-format check. Trustees' committees: names as printed in the roster; ACMs marked with a single * in this report ('*Appointed Committee Member') are type 'appointed'. Michele G. (G.S.B. chair) is ex officio on all trustees' committees and the G.S.O. general manager on all except Audit, Compensation and Nominating (footnote) - not listed as members; Michele G.'s trustee_committees is therefore empty. International committee secretary printed as 'Mary C., acting secretary' (retired staff member/staff consultant, acting International desk coordinator). ICRF has two secretaries: Sandra W. (International Conventions) and James H. (Regional Forums), stored as 'Sandra W.; James H.'. trustee_committees for trustees/directors are derived from the trustees' committee roster (bios also mention non-roster committees such as Strategic Planning, Retirement, Orientation, A.A.W.S.
